ListPreference.android:summary: Euclidean (default; affine view) or Poincaré disk (the Circle Limit projection)

SeekBarPreference.android:title: World-to-disk scale
SeekBarPreference.android:summary: How aggressively world radius squeezes into the disk. Low → big tiles near the centre, far tiles compress to the boundary; high → the whole tiling is small and central. 50 = default.

SeekBarPreference.android:title: Disk centre — X
SeekBarPreference.android:summary: Hyperbolic translation along the X axis. 50 = centred at the origin; 0/100 shifts the disk centre to b ≈ (-0.9, 0) / (+0.9, 0).

SeekBarPreference.android:title: Disk centre — Y
SeekBarPreference.android:summary: Hyperbolic translation along the Y axis. 50 = centred at the origin.

SeekBarPreference.android:title: Edge polyline subdivision
SeekBarPreference.android:summary: Each tile edge is split into this many sub-segments before projection. 1 = straight chord (cheapest); 16 reads as a true geodesic arc at typical zoom. Triggers a geometry rebuild.
